layman_headline: Market fear is high and altcoins look weak — patience is the best play right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful state with the Fear & Greed Index sitting at 27 and trending worse. Bitcoin is down about 2% over the past week while most altcoins are in deeper downtrends with bearish chart patterns. Today there's a modest bounce across the board (most coins up 3-5%), but the overall structure still looks weak — this bounce could easily be a dead cat bounce rather than a real reversal. None of the swing trade candidates offer a compelling risk/reward setup right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market hasn't finished correcting yet, and jumping in during a fearful bounce without strong technical confirmation is how people get caught in falling knives. Watch for the Fear & Greed Index to bottom and start turning up, or for a clear oversold bounce setup with chart confirmation.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven candidates systematically. KAITO has the strongest chart bias (+1.1) but an RSI of 87 is dangerously overbought — this is a -2.0 score on my most reliable indicator. BONK and PENGU show oversold RSI (my best signal historically at 71% win rate), but both have strongly bearish chart structures with bearish engulfing and evening star patterns respectively. The risk/reward on PENGU is terrible at 0.36x. WLD has decent R/R at 4.35x but is below all MAs with a slightly bearish chart. ENA shows an evening star reversal pattern at -1.7 chart bias despite the 11% daily bounce. UB has no chart data or RSI available — insufficient data to evaluate. BTC dominance at 56.3% signals capital flowing away from alts, making altcoin entries riskier. With Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening, per my validated rules, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and holding is the safer call.
